title.narrative: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Reform

description.narrative: The Attorney-General's Department's (AGD) contribution to Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Reform expands on the existing Pacific Law and Justice Program, and aims to modernise Pacific island countries' policing, law enforcement and criminal justice legislation and policies. This enables law and justice, policing and prosecution agencies to respond more effectively to law and justice issues, in particular on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing issues. AGD works with Pacific island countries and the Australian Federal Police and the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade to develop and implement key components of an improved criminal justice system, both bilaterally and regionally. The Non-ODA component supports the undertaking of projects, including capacity development, that may not meet the ODA eligible guidelines.

organisation.narrative: Australia - Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
